purpose: Bounded descriptive parser-induced measurement discrepancy against a converted-manual treebank reference; no author, human-origin or style model.

selection.unit: one treebank sentence-level record, not a verified independent original work
selection.rule: Within each n/w sent_id prefix, sort ascending by SHA256(UTF8(seed + sent_id)), tie break exact sent_id; take first 32 without replacement or outcome-based exclusions.
selection.private_manifest: IDs, byte spans, exact texts and selected-unit hashes remain outside repository; only manifest digest published.
selection.independence: No author/work independence is inferred from sentence IDs or newdoc labels. No sentence-IID confidence intervals.

reference_policy.source: Exact UTF-8 decoded # text field; LF container framing removed, content unchanged; no NFC, whitespace, simplified/traditional or punctuation normalization.
reference_policy.token_alignment: Integer rows aligned sequentially to exact FORM; skip only existing whitespace between tokens. No fuzzy alignment or text reconstruction. Any unmatched nonwhitespace, MWT, empty-node, invalid tree or absent field makes reference unavailable for that record, retained in coverage.
reference_policy.offsets: Unicode codepoint half-open offsets into exact # text, plus private original file byte location.
reference_policy.reference_status: converted_manual_treebank_reference in a separate evaluator dataclass; never synthetic_fixture or automatic_unvalidated.
reference_policy.relations: Basic HEAD and DEPREL; enhanced DEPS not evaluated. Full subtype and base relation agreement reported separately. No convention remapping.

arms.production: Unmodified LocalStanza raw-text path with punctuation-lines/1.0.0, Stanza1.10.1 zh-hans GSDSimp nocharlm/resources1.10.0, CPU2 threads. Each selected record independently.
arms.reference_token_control: Same loaded POS/lemma/depparse weights, original text and exact reference token offsets, tokenizer bypassed. Supply only token IDs, FORM and offsets, never reference POS, HEAD, DEPREL, FEATS or lemma. Descriptive oracle-tokenization diagnostic, not production accuracy.
arms.common_gate: Reference exact-text alignment and legal tree, exactly one production source segment covering entire text, successful production parse, successful reference-token control. All other selected records retained in coverage with reasons.

metrics.tokenization: Exact token span equality, all tokens including punctuation; micro precision, recall and F1, unmatched counts; lexical reference stratum additionally reported.
metrics.upos: UPOS accuracy conditional on exact-span-aligned dependent tokens, plus correct-UPOS/reference-token recall so unmatched reference tokens count against recall.
metrics.dependency: Head correctness compares exact original head spans or explicit root sentinel; correct dependent token and head span required. UAS, full LAS and base LAS conditional on aligned dependents, plus corresponding recall over all reference tokens. Punctuation-inclusive and reference-lexical strata. No custom score is called CoNLL official LAS.
metrics.coverage: Every selected record/reference integer row enters accounting before gates. Report reference alignment failure, operational boundary mismatch, parse failures, scoring cohort, reference/model tokens and edge endpoint opportunity counts.
metrics.features: Use frozen 71-channel _aggregate arithmetic separately on model/control/reference analyses for each common-gate record, without production provenance certification. Per-channel paired count, missing counts/reasons, denominator sums, event support, signed bias, MAE, maximum absolute discrepancy, and same-support aggregate discrepancy. Never combine unlike channel scales into a score.
metrics.history: content_overlap, trigram_reuse and initial_pos_reuse are unavailable: corpus records lack verified contiguous prior context; do not report first-record zero as validated reuse.
metrics.short_windows: MATTR100, lexical entropy100 and POS bigram entropy100 only if genuine within-record 100-token windows exist on both sides; never concatenate randomly sampled records or shrink windows. Missing support is unvalidated, not zero.
metrics.zero_events: Zero is observed only for positive opportunity; channels with no reference/model events are marked no-positive-event evidence, not validated detectors.
metrics.uncertainty: Finite benchmark descriptive counts only. No calibrated parser probabilities or author/work population confidence claims.
metrics.conventions: Report documented GSDSimp/PUD differences, unsupported label inventories and aligned POS/dependency confusion aggregates separately; do not causally assign all disagreements to parser errors or erase them with remapping.

restrictions.publication: Methods, aggregate errors and coverage, corpus/model identity and source links only. No raw texts, sentence IDs, per-record offsets, per-record hashes or reconstructable parses.
restrictions.module_frozen: No changes to research/linguistic files, original schema or parser.

overlap_status: PUD is a separate named treebank from pinned GSDSimp supervised metadata. Actual training-text overlap, prior PUD exposure and fastText Common Crawl/Wikipedia overlap not audited; not a truly-unseen generalization claim.
